name: supply-sophie-unanswered-round
narrative: Sophie runs RUTF procurement for the Connect-RUTF program. Round 1's 2,000 cartons, ordered from Harmattan in July, are still not in Kano, and 17 days ago she asked six suppliers to quote round 2: half have never answered, despite two reminders, and she forwards whatever does arrive to an AI that records it. Sophie opens round 2 and reads who answered and who has said nothing, how long each has been silent and when she last chased them, and that the round has not yet settled how import duties are handled. She opens the reminder drafted for Sahel, which says when Sahel was asked and last reminded, and records today's chase from the draft itself. Sahel answers with a quote; Sophie forwards it, sees Sahel's row move to replied, and opens Sahel's own email in the round's history beside what the AI recorded from it. On the comparison only Harmattan's quote can be compared on landed total: Kanem's has not stated how many sachets are in a carton, and Sahel's gives no freight figure, no duty figure and no exchange rate, while the round's duty terms are still not settled. Northgate's questions are waiting on her, and she answers the one about who imports: we import, under the program's duty waiver; please state freight to Kano. She marks that answer as the round's import duty terms, and the round's header now reads them, for every quote on the round. Importing makes the paperwork hers, and round 1 shows what that means: on the order with Harmattan, the forwarder's message says the trucks are held at the border on our import permit, so the next move is hers, not the supplier's, and Harmattan's invoice is flagged above the agreed price. Back on her overview, Sophie reads who is still silent, what each quote still lacks, and whose move each thing is.

sophie.intro: Sophie buys RUTF for the Connect-RUTF program; suppliers and the freight forwarder email her, and she forwards what they send to an AI that records it.
sophie.name: Sophie

features.description: Tender page header shows the round's label and that it is open past its deadline.
features.verify: Playwright: /supply/procurement/tenders/<round2>/ shows 'RUTF round 2' and 'deadline passed' with '(3 days ago)'

features.description: Outreach table shows reply day/kind, silence since the ask, and Last chased with the reminder count.
features.verify: Playwright: the Sahel Nutrition Industries row shows 'No reply · 17 days' and its Last chased cell reads '2nd reminder'

features.description: The Outreach heading counts replies of all asked.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=outreach-replied-count] reads '3 of 6 replied'

features.description: The tender header carries a line stating the round's import duty terms, reading not settled until a value is set.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=tender-duty-terms] reads 'Import duties: not settled'

scenes.narrative: Round 1's cartons are still not in Kano, and Sophie asked six suppliers to quote round 2; only three of the six have replied, though she chased the others twice. She opens the round and reads who answered and who is silent, how long each has been silent and when she last chased them, and that the round has not settled how import duties are handled. She wants the record to keep telling her the truth: what the answers left out, and whose move it is.
scenes.title: Half the round never answered

features.description: The drafts panel lists a Reminder draft for each of the three silent suppliers.
features.verify: Playwright: #drafts contains 3 drafts labelled 'Reminder', one for Sahel Nutrition Industries

features.description: Each reminder draft says when the supplier was asked and last reminded.
features.verify: Playwright: Sahel's draft [data-testid=draft-why] contains 'no reply is recorded' and 'last reminded on'

features.description: A reminder draft carries a Chased on date, defaulting to today, and a Record chase button that saves last_reminder_on and returns to the round with Sahel's Last chased cell marked.
features.verify: Playwright: Sahel's draft shows [data-testid=chase-date] and a 'Record chase' button; after clicking it, tr[data-changed] is Sahel Nutrition Industries' row

scenes.narrative: Sophie opens the round's draft emails and reads the reminder drafted for Sahel: it says when Sahel was asked and when she last reminded them, and under the message the Chased on field already holds today's date beside Record chase, so the chase she sends is recorded from the draft itself.
scenes.title: She chases Sahel from a drafted reminder

features.description: Between scenes 2 and 3 the AI records Sahel's emailed quote and reply over the labs MCP with source ref, excerpt and sender.
features.verify: Django shell: the program's newest OperationCall rows are quote_record and outreach_update on channel 'mcp' with source_sender 'Amadou Issoufou, Sahel Nutrition Industries'

features.description: A Replies only toggle on the round's history shows just the entries recorded from an email.
features.verify: Playwright: after clicking [data-testid=history-replies-only], no 'Last chased' bookkeeping line is visible and Sahel's email event is first

features.description: Each email event shows the sender, the AI recorder and the excerpt behind one Source email toggle.
features.verify: Playwright: Sahel's email event, opened, shows 'Amadou Issoufou, Sahel Nutrition Industries' and an excerpt containing 'EUR 0.31 per sachet'

scenes.narrative: Sahel answers the reminder with a quote and Sophie forwards it to the AI; Sahel's row on the round moves to replied. In the round's history, turned to replies only, she opens Sahel's own email: who sent it, the excerpt of what Sahel wrote, and below it what the AI recorded from it, so she can check the record against Sahel's words.
scenes.title: Sahel finally answers, and she opens the email

features.description: The comparison page compares Harmattan's quote on landed total and names what blocks the others: sachets per carton on Kanem's; the exchange rate, the freight amount and the duties amount on Sahel's.
features.verify: Playwright: /compare/ reads '1 of 3 quotes can be compared on landed total'; Harmattan Therapeutics is under Comparable with a landed total; the Kanem Foods Ltd card shows 'Blocking: Sachets per carton not stated on the quote'; the Sahel Nutrition Industries card shows 'Quote is in EUR and no exchange rate was recorded', 'Freight excluded from the quote but no freight amount recorded' and 'Duties excluded from the quote but no duties amount recorded', and no quantity mismatch

scenes.narrative: Sophie opens the comparison and reads what each answer still lacks: only Harmattan's quote can be compared on landed total, Kanem's has not stated how many sachets are in a carton, and Sahel's new quote gives no freight figure, no duty figure and no exchange rate, while the round's duty terms are not settled, so its landed cost can't be worked out yet.
scenes.title: An answer is not yet a quote she can compare

features.description: The What we owe them section lists Northgate's open questions with raised day and text.
features.verify: Playwright: #owed shows 3 rows under 'Northgate Commodities' with '3 questions', each reading how many days it has been open

features.description: The Mark answered form carries a select [data-testid=answer-duty-terms] (name duty_terms), labelled 'This answer sets the round's import duty terms'; submitting with a value records the answer and sets the tender's duty terms as an attributed operation with a Revision.
features.verify: Playwright: the resolve form shows 'This answer sets the round's import duty terms'; after choosing buyer_waiver and Save, the importer question's answer reads 'We import, under the program's duty waiver; please state freight to Kano.'

features.description: The tender header's duty terms line reads the terms just set, with who set them, carrying the just-changed marker.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=tender-duty-terms] contains 'Import duties: we import, under the program's duty waiver' and 'by Sophie'

scenes.narrative: Back on the round, Sophie reads Northgate's open questions, recorded as answers she owes, and answers the one about who imports for her reply to Northgate: we import, under the program's duty waiver; please state freight to Kano. She marks that answer as setting the round's import duty terms, and the round's header now reads that we import under the program's duty waiver, set by Sophie, for every quote on the round.
scenes.title: One answer to Northgate settles the round's duties

features.description: Order page shows a Waiting on us banner naming the owed import permit when a shipment requires it and it is not on file.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=waiting-on-us] contains 'import permit' and the page has no 'past the promised lead time' banner

features.description: The order timeline names Crescent Freight & Clearing as the sender of the status change, from source.sender.
features.verify: Playwright: order #history shows 'from Crescent Freight & Clearing'

features.description: Order page banner lists each invoice line above the contract with billed vs agreed.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=invoice-above-contract] contains '51.20' and '49.80'

scenes.narrative: Importing makes the paperwork hers, and round 1 shows what that means. On the order with Harmattan, the order says it is waiting on us for the import permit, and the forwarder's message in its history says the trucks are held at the border until it is lodged, so the next move is hers, not the supplier's; and Harmattan's invoice is flagged above the agreed price, billed against agreed.
scenes.title: Round 1's order: held on our permit, billed high

features.description: Overview row for round 2 reads 'No reply: Lagoon Nutripharm, Savanna Ready Foods' once Sahel has answered.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=standing-table] round 2 row contains 'No reply', 'Lagoon Nutripharm' and 'Savanna Ready Foods', and 'answers to Northgate Commodities'

features.description: Overview row for the round 1 order reads 'Us: import permit'.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=standing-table] contains 'import permit'

features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=standing-table] contains 'Sahel Nutrition Industries (exchange rate, freight amount)' and not 'duties amount'

scenes.narrative: Back on her overview, Sophie reads who is still silent, what each quote still lacks and whose move each thing is: round 2 waiting on two suppliers who have not replied and on her remaining answers to Northgate, Sahel's quote on its exchange rate and freight, and the round 1 order on her import permit.
scenes.title: Who is silent, and whose move each thing is
